protocol.measure: Use the fixed serving local luma selector and rectangle. Refine only its time range from the original seed tile, requiring consecutive above-point measurements and abrupt boundaries relative to both flanks. The output abstains unless both endpoints qualify. The existing point and region stay fixed.
protocol.held: Use the first eight archived CREMA-D originals by asset index after excluding the actor groups of the previous paired luma and extent studies. Test two newly authored abrupt local changes and one gradual local transition per group at prespecified odd lengths, plus neutral H.264 delivery, global grade and wrong-source cases. These cameras had prior exposure in unrelated project experiments.
protocol.diagnostic: Use 17 previously exposed native LivePortrait and MuseTalk redraws, without fitting or modifying the candidate, and report the independently timing-qualified subset. This is not a fresh neural holdout.
protocol.gate: For fresh abrupt edits require at least 12 of 16 exact intervals, an increase of at least six across four groups, zero worsening by more than one frame at either edge, and at most one newly asserted abrupt fade. For native redraws, combined endpoint error may not worsen on either generator or timing-qualified median, and may worsen by more than two frames per endpoint on at most one clip. Neutral, wrong-source, and existing finding status must stay unchanged. No previously supported abrupt or neural crop may fall below 0.10 pixel IoU at the selected middle picture.
